name: Integrate ORODI into the Craft Product construction chain
outcome: Establish six stable Craft Product Capability identities for operational resilience, bind their business ontology and DomainSpec v2 profile to explicit admission owners, and carry each capability through a Project-owned D65 ConstructionBinding without inflating implementation or runtime evidence.
rationale: ORODI already has source-bound business meaning, a deterministic DomainSpec graph, a candidate system ontology, one implemented contract vertical, and explicit residues. It needs Product and Project ownership so later implementation, conformance, and commissioning remain interpretable and owner-controlled.
success_conditions: The Craft Project references this Goal and all six ORODI ConstructionBindings. Acceptance: Project and Goal schemas validate and references close bidirectionally.

All six ORODI outcomes have stable CAV2-D67 Product Capability candidate identities and immutable record digests. Acceptance: The capability package validates the shared Product Capability shape and canonical record hashes.

Business ontology and DomainSpec profile admission are decided by their named owners against immutable candidate digests. Acceptance: Owner decisions name exact candidate paths and SHA-256 digests; changed bytes require successor decisions.

Each capability crosses D65 to independently assessed static conformance and bounded runtime evidence. Acceptance: Registered construction records contain validated predecessors, exact implementation targets, independent conformance, and capability-specific runtime evidence.
evidence_requirements: Product Capability adoption, business ontology admission, and DomainSpec profile admission remain separate digest-bound decisions.
Project ownership coordinates work but grants no implementation or effect authority.
Planned implementation files remain absent evidence rather than inferred implementation.
Commissioning requires a later exact effect authorization and complete teardown evidence.
claim_ceiling: Prepared Goal/v1 candidate for the current ORODI objective; no achievement, graph-membership admission or execution authority.
